text:
Maria Chen: Quick follow-up to the RFC — proposing extracting the enrichment pipeline (the 'enricher') + a tenant-routing facade from runtime to reduce hotpath complexity. High-level goals: isolate stateful enrichment, make model-adapter stateless, reduce tail-latency blast radius. Questions: ownership of KV cache, rollout strategy, SLA targets, and test harness.

Samir Patel: +1 on extraction. The enrichment code is messy and touches a lot of runtime internals. Concern: migrating per-tenant caches. If we move cache out, we need consistent eviction semantics.

Devon Li: My main worry is latency SLOs. Enricher adds variability. Suggest co-locating a cache sidecar behind a fast IPC layer for first-phase.

Kat Moore: Ops perspective: need a clear fallback path. Proposed 3-phase rollout: 
phase 0: read-only proxy -> enricher (shadow) for perf and correctness
phase 1: canary 1% traffic -> enricher with sync cache updates
phase 2: cutoff + traffic shift
Will also require runbook for rollback + DB migration plan.

Maria Chen: Nice. For interfaces I propose the facade uses a small surface: 
```
POST /enrich -> { tenant_id, session_id, input } -> { enriched }
GET /enrich/state/{tenant_id}/{key}
```
Immutable response contract, versioned via header `X-Enrich-Version`.
Keep model adapters behind it.

Samir Patel: Agree on small surface. Also we should support a `?prefer_cache=true` hint to allow fast-path behaviour.

Devon Li: Testing: create perf harness that replays 30m of production traffic with 99th-latency target <= 120ms for hot keys. If sidecar IPC adds <4ms it's ok.

Kat Moore: Observability: emit enrich_id, route_version, cache_hit boolean, p50/p95/p99 histograms. Wire alerts for p99 > 250ms or cache_hit rate drop > 10%.

arch-bot: deploy pipeline note: created pipeline `enricher-extract` in CI (link: https://ci.internal/enricher-extract). Auto-canary enabled.

Maria Chen: Ownership proposal: Eng-ML owns code, Eng-Platform owns infra+sidecar, Eng-SRE owns runbooks/alerts. Any objections?

Samir Patel: fine by me. I'll draft the migration playbook and the API compatibility test. 

Devon Li: I'll build the harness and a lightweight sidecar prototype.

Kat Moore: I'll schedule a dry-run during low traffic window and add rollback steps. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll push an updated RFC with phases and estimated timelines (ETA: EOD Friday).
